# llm-scripts

> Run GGUF models on AMD APU hardware through one engine-neutral runner. It
> detects the hardware, resolves a model file, solves a memory-aware profile,
> renders that profile into engine argv, and runs the server. Two engines are
> supported: llama.cpp (the SyntheticAutonomicMind fork) and gufo. No system
> ROCm install is required - `scripts/build.sh` downloads a pinned SDK into
> `deps/`. Vulkan (RADV) is the default llama.cpp backend on RDNA iGPUs; gufo
> targets ROCm/HIP on gfx1151.

## Why

Agentic AI development on AMD APUs without network access. No API keys, no
per-token costs, no cloud dependency. The primary target is a Strix Halo APU
(Ryzen AI Max+ 395, Radeon 8060S, 128 GB unified memory). The detection map
also covers the Radeon 780M (7840U), Vega 8 (5800H), and other RDNA2/RDNA3
APUs.

## Quick start

```bash
git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/fewtarius/llm-scripts.git
cd llm-scripts
./scripts/build.sh --gufo          # gufo into build/gufo/
./scripts/build.sh --vulkan        # llama.cpp Vulkan into build/llama-vulkan/
./llm models
./llm serve --engine gufo Laguna-S-2.1-UD-Q4_K_XL
```

## Key features

- Auto GPU/CPU detection (PCI ID, amd-smi, CPU ISA, Cezanne through Strix Halo)
- Build orchestration for Vulkan, ROCm, and Metal, plus gufo, from one script
- Optimistic-first solver reads GGUF metadata and detunes until the allocation
  fits the measured GPU budget
- One generic option vocabulary translated per engine by the adapter
- GTT memory configuration via kernel parameters (VRAM left at firmware default)
- Model download with split-shard assembly, size and SHA-256 verification
- MoE expert tracking, multi-agent parallel slots, reasoning model support

## Repo structure

- `llm` - main entry point (serve, profile, models, pull, build, doctor, env)
- `lib/` - hardware detection, model resolution, profile, process, env, validate
- `solver/llama.sh` - optimistic-first llama.cpp solver
- `solver/gufo.sh` - gufo policy solver
- `lib/engines/` - per-engine adapter (solve, render, env, binary, readiness)
- `scripts/build.sh` - shared build front end (ROCm SDK download, dispatch, wrappers)
- `scripts/build/` - one build script per target (llama-rocm, llama-vulkan, llama-metal, gufo)
- `scripts/benchmark.sh` - llama.cpp benchmark suite (cache, bench, batched)
- `scripts/log_analyzer.py` - server log to metrics and Markdown
- `scripts/apply-ttm-kernel-params.sh` - GTT kernel parameter configuration
- `scripts/install-deps.sh` - system dependency installer
- `tools/` - GGUF metadata, PLE sizing, and drafter validation readers
- `llama.cpp/`, `gufo/` - submodules

## Documentation

- README.md - full documentation
- AGENTS.md - technical reference for AI agents
- SOLVER.md - solver algorithm and tuning details
- `.clio/instructions.md` - collaboration methodology
